content.text:
OpenClaw wants to be your local-first AI assistant

It runs across macOS, iOS, and Android, then meets you in the channels you already use. Voice in, voice out, plus a live Canvas when text is not enough. The Gateway is the control plane; the assistant is the product.

Star it if you want AI you own.

#ai #opensource #localfirst #devtools #assistant #macos #android
